period: Treasury 2022 market rows; current FEMA NRI county baseline
classification: Each ZCTA is assigned the county with the largest reported ZCTA land-area part; county-level FEMA EAL rating is then attached.
limits: ZCTA-to-county assignment is an area-based approximation and discards secondary county intersections.
The FEMA NRI release/version is not a 2022 household or insurance-market observation and has temporal and modeled-risk limitations.
Treasury metrics are not household-level, the workbook is not a complete insurer census, and results are unweighted means of ZIP rows.
Joined differences are descriptive and do not identify hazard causation, affordability, nonrenewal mechanism, repairs, mobility, or politics.
